record.paper_title: Syzygies of projective varieties of large degree: recent progress and open problems.
record.original_question: Let X be a smooth projective variety of dimension at least 2, let B be a line bundle on X, and let L_d be sufficiently positive. Find necessary and sufficient conditions for the vanishing of K_{p,1}(X,B;L_d) for all large d. In particular, determine whether failure of p-jet very ampleness should force non-vanishing, or whether a subtler condition involving smoothable zero-dimensional subschemes is required.

evidence.quote: To complete this picture, there remains:
Problem 4.12. Find necessary and suﬃcient conditions for the vanishing ofKp,1(X,B ;Ld) when d ≫ 0.

It does not seem out of the question that the failure of B to be p-jet very ample in general implies the non-vanishing of this group. We had originally imagined the p-very amplitude ofB would control the matter, but a heuristic argument due to Yang casts some doubt on this possibility.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective variety of dimension $n \geq 2$, let $B$ be a line bundle on $X$, and let $\{L_d\}$ be a family of line bundles on $X$ that becomes sufficiently positive as $d \to \infty$ (for instance, $L_d = dA + P$ for a fixed ample divisor $A$ and an arbitrary divisor $P$, with $d \gg 0$).

For a line bundle $L$ on $X$ that is very ample, embedding $X \hookrightarrow \mathbb{P}H^0(X,L)^*$, and for any line bundle $B$, define the Koszul cohomology group
$$K_{p,1}(X, B; L) = \ker\bigl(\wedge^p H^0(L) \otimes H^0(B) \to \wedge^{p-1} H^0(L) \otimes H^0(B+L)\bigr) \big/ \mathrm{im}\bigl(\wedge^{p+1} H^0(L) \otimes H^0(B-L) \to \wedge^p H^0(L) \otimes H^0(B)\bigr),$$
the space of weight-one degree-$p$ syzygies of $B$ with respect to $L$.

Recall the following positivity notions for $B$:
- $B$ is $p$-very ample if for every zero-dimensional subscheme $\xi \subset X$ of length $p+1$, the restriction map $H^0(X,B) \to H^0(\xi, B|_\xi)$ is surjective.
- $B$ is $p$-jet very ample if for every effective zero-cycle $w = a_1 x_1 + \cdots + a_s x_s$ on $X$ with $\sum a_i = p+1$, the restriction map $H^0(X,B) \to H^0(B \otimes \mathcal{O}_X / \mathfrak{m}_{x_1}^{a_1} \cdots \mathfrak{m}_{x_s}^{a_s})$ is surjective.

It is known that if $B$ is $p$-jet very ample, then $K_{p,1}(X, B; L_d) = 0$ for all $d \gg 0$, and that if there is a reduced length-$(p+1)$ subscheme of $X$ failing to impose independent conditions on $|B|$, then $K_{p,1}(X, B; L_d) \neq 0$ for all $d \gg 0$.

Problem. Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $(X, B)$ for the vanishing $K_{p,1}(X, B; L_d) = 0$ for all $d \gg 0$. In particular, decide whether the failure of $B$ to be $p$-jet very ample always forces $K_{p,1}(X, B; L_d) \neq 0$ for $d \gg 0$, or whether the correct criterion involves a subtler condition phrased in terms of smoothable zero-dimensional subschemes of $X$ of length $p+1$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem asks for an exact criterion bridging known sufficient ($p$-jet very ampleness) and necessary (failure of $p$-very ampleness via reduced subschemes) conditions for asymptotic vanishing of $K_{p,1}$. Recent work (e.g. arXiv:2511.12994, 2025) continues to study sufficient conditions for vanishing of weight-one syzygies but does not provide a complete necessary-and-sufficient characterization. A 2025 Math. Annalen paper by Ein–Lazarsfeld–Yang on asymptotic nonvanishing of syzygies addresses related directions. No source verifies a definitive resolution of the precise necessary-and-sufficient question, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A vanishing theorem for weight one syzygies (Ein–Lazarsfeld–Yang)
status_evidence.snippet: If B is p-jet very ample then K_{p,1}(X,B;L_d)=0 for d≫0; converse via reduced subschemes failing to impose independent conditions.
status_evidence.claim: States the known sufficient condition and a partial converse, leaving the gap noted in Problem 4.12.

status_evidence.title: Vanishing of weight one syzygies of projective varieties (Basu, 2025)
status_evidence.snippet: We study conditions under which weight one Koszul cohomology vanishes on projective varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Continued investigation of vanishing criteria, indicating the question remains active.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic nonvanishing of syzygies of algebraic varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Study of asymptotic nonvanishing of syzygies.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on the nonvanishing side, complementing but not resolving the necessary-and-sufficient criterion.
